method.selection_policy: LLM-selected market-relevant items from news_digest.json; preserves source metadata and excludes noise.

framework.Equities: Broad equity/risk sentiment; market-moving mega-cap/AI allowed; low-signal single-stock noise excluded.
framework.Commodities: Physical commodity futures framework; supply disruption/demand strength positive; supply increase/demand weakness negative.
framework.FX: USD-centric basket; non-USD currency strength positive; USD/DXY strength negative.
framework.Rates: Bond-price framework; yields up/selloff/higher-for-longer negative; yields down/bond rally/cooler inflation positive.

Equities.title: Oil heads for $100, Asia stocks subdued as Middle East tensions escalate
Equities.reason: Oil surge tied to Middle East escalation is a broad risk-off driver — raises input costs, hits sentiment for global cyclicals and growth stocks, and increases market volatility. High relevance to overall equity regime.

Equities.title: AI infrastructure stocks rally on deal announcements from Qualcomm, Corning
Equities.summary: Shares of Qualcom, Corning, Intel, Advanced Micro Devices and others tied to the AI infrastructure trade popped on Tuesday.
Equities.reason: Dealflow and bullish headlines around AI infrastructure reinforce the market leadership narrative for AI-related tech stocks, supporting equity risk appetite within the tech/AI theme.

Equities.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang declares 'AGI has arrived' after OpenAI unveils GPT-6 Astra
Equities.reason: Strong bullish narrative for AI leadership and incumbents (notably Nvidia); supportive for mega-cap tech and the broader AI-led market regime, though company-centric, it feeds the dominant market theme.

Equities.title: Canada's retaliatory tariffs worth CA$27.6 billion take effect as trade rift with U.S. deepens
Equities.summary: Duties on Canadian imports of U.S. steel and aluminum products have doubled to 50% as a trade war between Washington and Ottawa intensifies.
Equities.reason: Escalating US-Canada trade measures raise policy and earnings risk for cross-border industrials, materials and consumer supply chains — a meaningful but sector-focused negative for equities.

Equities.title: US bans Canadian dairy, motorcycles and most alcoholic beverages
Equities.summary: Move comes a day after Ottawa imposes $20bn in retaliatory tariffs on US goods
Equities.reason: Further escalation of trade restrictions amplifies geopolitical/policy uncertainty and could dent investor confidence in North American consumer and industrial names; moderate relevance to broad market.

Equities.title: S&P 500 falls as AI worries hit software makers
Equities.reason: Weakness in software names tied to AI execution concerns feeds short-term volatility in the index and signals rotation within tech; a negative intra-tech signal with broader index implications.

Equities.title: Stock Market News, Sept. 8, 2026: Dow Drops 628 Points, Oil Marches Toward $100
Equities.reason: Large one-day market selloff tied to geopolitical/oil-driven risk-off and sector rotation — notable market-impact event reinforcing a cautious near-term equity regime.

Rates.title: Japan’s Rising Yields Stir Debate Over Growing Repatriation Risk
Rates.reason: Rising JGB yields signal a bond selloff and higher term premia; repatriation debate implies upward pressure on global yields and stress on duration. High relevance for global rates given Japan's market size and BOJ involvement.

Rates.title: China Plans to Let $568 Billion Fund Tap Southbound Bond Connect
Rates.reason: Expansion of Bond Connect access changes cross-border demand dynamics for fixed income; likely supportive for bond prices in the accessible market(s) by broadening investor base and structural demand.

Rates.title: China Banks Snap Up Bonds to Seek Returns as Loan Slump Deepens
Rates.reason: Banks increasing purchases of bonds to offset weak lending boosts domestic bond demand, supporting prices (lower yields). High relevance given scale and potential to alter local yield curves.

Rates.title: 0.8%: China’s CPI inflation rises in August
Rates.summary: China’s Consumer Price Index (CPI) climbed 0.8% in August from a year ago after arriving at a rise of 0.5% in Juuly, the National Bureau of Statistics of China reported on Wednesday. The market consensus was for 0.8% in the reported period.
Rates.reason: CPI uptick increases the case for less near-term easing from Chinese authorities and can put modest upward pressure on local yields; relevant for Asia fixed income and global inflation perception.

Rates.title: China's wholesale inflation tops estimates in August on commodity costs, tech demand as consumer price increases meet forecast
Rates.summary: Much of the anticipated pickup reflects a favorable base-effect comparison and higher commodity costs, rather than a genuine strengthening in household demand.
Rates.reason: Stronger-than-expected wholesale inflation (PPI) points to input-cost pressures that can feed through to rates, increasing the risk of higher yields if sustained; material for bond market inflation expectations.

Rates.title: Warsh might yet be a good Fed chair
Rates.summary: He must stay clear on the objectives of policy and sensible on how the central bank should conduct itself
Rates.reason: Discussion about potential Fed leadership can shift market perceptions of future policy stance; editorial tone implies governance and credibility considerations with modest tilt toward possible hawkish credibility — limited immediacy for rates.

Rates.title: AI borrowing boom shakes up Swiss credit market
Rates.summary: Bonds from the likes of Alphabet and Amazon have accounted for more than a quarter of Swiss franc corporate issuance this year
Rates.reason: Surge in corporate issuance increases supply in the Swiss franc credit market, putting pressure on corporate bond prices and potentially widening spreads; modest spillover to broader rates/credit conditions.

FX.title: Euro grinds higher above 1.1600, traders await ECB rate decision, US inflation data
FX.summary: The EUR/USD pair gains traction to near 1.1630 during the early Asian trading hours on Wednesday. Expectations of a rate hike from the European Central Bank (ECB) provide some support to the Euro (EUR) against the US Dollar (USD). ECB President Christine Lagar
FX.reason: EUR strength vs USD tied to ECB rate-hike expectations ahead of a key meeting and US inflation — clear USD-centric FX transmission. Medium-high relevance as ECB decision is a near-term macro driver for EUR/USD.

FX.title: United States Dollar Index weakens despite rising inflation concerns, Fed rate hike bets
FX.summary: The US Dollar Index (DXY), which measures the value of the US Dollar (USD) against six major currencies, is losing ground for the third consecutive day and trading around 98.80 during Asian hours on Wednesday.
FX.reason: Direct DXY move — broad USD weakness is the dominant cross-market FX narrative, underpinning gains in EUR/GBP/AUD/CAD/JPY. High relevance given DXY’s market-wide transmission.

FX.title: Japanese Yen gathers strength as BoJ hike bets ramp up
FX.summary: The USD/JPY pair loses momentum to around 153.55 during the early Asian session on Wednesday. The Japanese Yen (JPY) strengthens against the US Dollar (USD) as Bank of Japan (BoJ) policymakers opened the door for a rate hike in September.
FX.reason: BoJ tightening expectations are a major regime change for G10 FX — a strong, direct bullish impulse for JPY vs USD and a material shift in carry/positioning. High direction and relevance to reflect market-moving potential.

FX.title: JPMorgan Sees Yen Rally, Lower Yields Speeding Japan AI Recovery
FX.reason: Sell-side forecast/commentary from a major bank reinforcing a yen-recovery narrative and linking FX to global yield/tech flows — supports conviction behind JPY strength and positioning moves.

FX.title: Swiss Franc strengthens as US Dollar holds losses despite Fed rate hike odds
FX.summary: USD/CHF loses ground for the third consecutive day, trading around 0.8090 during the Asian hours on Wednesday. The pair remains subdued as the US Dollar (USD) holds losses despite a hawkish tone surrounding the Federal Reserve (Fed) policy outlook.
FX.reason: CHF appreciating as part of the broader USD-weakness theme; direct USD/CHF move is relevant but more idiosyncratic than EUR/JPY moves, so moderate relevance.

FX.title: Canadian Dollar gains amid elevated oil prices, escalating US trade sanctions
FX.summary: USD/CAD remains subdued for the third successive day, trading around 1.3780 during the Asian hours on Wednesday. The currency pair loses ground as the commodity-linked Canadian Dollar (CAD) draws support from elevated oil prices, given Canada's position as one
FX.reason: CAD strength is explicitly tied to oil and trade tensions — clear FX-native transmission. Medium relevance as commodity-linked support reinforces non-USD appreciation.

FX.title: Australian Dollar remains on the front foot vs weak USD after China's inflation data
FX.summary: The AUD/USD pair sticks to its positive bias through the Asian session on Wednesday and trades around the 0.7220-0.7225 area, just below its highest level since May 14, touched the previous day. Spot prices, meanwhile, moved little following the release of Chi
FX.reason: AUD benefiting from both weak USD and China data — direct USD/AUD transmission with regional macro support. Relevance modest-high given China links.

FX.title: New Zealand Dollar holds gains above 0.5850 after Chinese inflation data
FX.summary: The NZD/USD pair gathers strength to around 0.5855 during the early Asian trading hours on Wednesday. The New Zealand Dollar (NZD) edges higher against the US Dollar (USD) following Chinese economic data. Traders will keep an eye on the US inflation data later
FX.reason: NZD gains are consistent with the broader USD-softness and China-driven demand signals; relevant but smaller market impact than G10 majors.

FX.title: Indian Rupee falls further as US-Iran tit-for-tat strikes boost oil prices
FX.summary: The Indian Rupee (INR) extends its decline against the US Dollar (USD) on Wednesday after a sharp correction the previous day. The USD/INR pair jumps marginally above 95.00 as surging energy prices have battered the Indian currency significantly.
FX.reason: INR weakness vs USD driven by oil and geopolitical risk — this represents a USD-strength/risk-off pocket within EMFX and is less central to G10 narratives, so moderate negative score.

Commodities.title: WTI surges as US strikes Iranian tankers
Commodities.summary: West Texas Intermediate (WTI) oil price extends its gains for the third successive day, trading around $92.30 during the Asian hours on Wednesday. Crude oil prices rise as the US struck several Iranian tankers near Kharg Island, a major crude export hub.
Commodities.reason: Direct supply-risk shock near Kharg elevates oil risk premium and is a dominant bullish driver for crude and related commodities (RBOB, diesel, refining margins). High market relevance.

Commodities.title: Oil nears $100 as US launches new strikes on Iranian tankers
Commodities.summary: American military hit ‘multiple’ ships linked to Iran’s Revolutionary Guards in response to more attempted missile attacks on a US Navy warship
Commodities.reason: Major media confirmation of escalating Middle East strikes reinforces upward pressure on oil prices and global supply-risk narrative.

Commodities.title: Elevated crack spreads and crude oil prices contribute to higher prices at the pump
Commodities.summary: What are crack spreads and why are they elevated? Crack spreads are indicators of the profitability of refining crude oil into petroleum products such as gasoline and diesel. One common crack spread is calculated by subtracting the spot market price of a gallo
Commodities.reason: Elevated crack spreads indicate refining tightness and stronger product margins, supporting refined-product prices and underpinning crude demand.

Commodities.title: U.S. LNG exports rose 23% in the first half of 2026 because of higher capacity
Commodities.summary: U.S. liquefied natural gas (LNG) exports averaged 17.4 billion cubic feet per day (Bcf/d) in the first six months of the year, 23% more than the same period in 2025, according to our Natural Gas Monthly. In our latest Short-Term Energy Outlook, we estimate U.S
Commodities.reason: Significant rise in LNG exports tightens global gas balances and supports natural gas prices; supply-side capacity expansion is supportive but gradual.

Commodities.title: Gold slumps to near $4,350 amid oil-driven inflation fears, US inflation data in focus
Commodities.summary: Gold price (XAU/USD) falls to near $4,350 during the early Asian session on Wednesday. The precious metal faces some selling pressure as rising oil prices fueled inflation ‌concerns and boosted expectations for a rate hike by the Federal Reserve (Fed) in Septe
Commodities.reason: Oil-driven inflation and tighter Fed-rate expectations create headwinds for gold (higher real/nominal rates), making this an important near-term metal narrative.

Commodities.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD rises to near $66.40 as US Dollar declines, US CPI in focus
Commodities.summary: Silver price (XAG/USD) is up almost 1% to near $66.40 during the Asian trading session on Wednesday. The white metal strengthens as the US Dollar remains under pressure despite expectations that the Federal Reserve (Fed) could raise interest rates at the polic
Commodities.reason: Silver is reacting to USD softness in the short run; metals nuance amid competing forces (USD, rates, oil-driven inflation). Medium-low relevance relative to dominant oil narrative.

Commodities.title: Rosneft Ships First Crude From $157 Billion Vostok Oil Project
Commodities.reason: New Russian crude shipments suggest additional supply entering the market — a modest bearish counterpoint to Middle East disruption; lower relevance vs. immediate Mideast shocks.

Commodities.title: Sudan Could Become the Red Sea’s Next Energy Security Flashpoint
Commodities.reason: Geopolitical risks in the Red Sea region could threaten shipping routes and add to oil supply-risk premium; supportive to energy complex but secondary to Strait of Hormuz developments.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin recovers toward $79,000 as Zcash records a $500 million ETF haul
Crypto.reason: Large ETF inflows (cross-product demand) indicate meaningful institutional/retail allocation into crypto, supporting BTC price and liquidity. High relevance because ETF flow narratives have been the dominant price driver recently.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin slips under $79,000, Zcash leads losses as Fed hike odds hold near 60%
Crypto.reason: Rising Fed hike odds create a higher-for-longer rates backdrop that pressures risk assets and crypto. This macro-rate headwind is a primary counterforce to ETF-driven flows, warranting material negative impact.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin ETFs are still $1 billion shy of breaking even in 2026
Crypto.reason: ETF flows remain significant but headline profitability underperformance suggests flows are not uniformly profitable and may limit further bullish conviction. Moderate negative signal on the ETF narrative's sustainability.

Crypto.title: Visa tells CNBC it is expanding data offering for blockchain lenders as demand for stablecoin-linked cards surges
Crypto.summary: Visa is doubling down on blockchain-powered financial services with a new program to help issuers of stablecoin-linked cards access loans.
Crypto.reason: Visa expanding data/financing for stablecoin-linked card issuers is a clear payments/rails adoption signal, improving utility and working-capital finance for crypto-native products. High relevance for institutional adoption and stablecoin utility.

Crypto.title: Circle agrees to buy cross-border payments firm Tazapay for $400 million
Crypto.reason: Strategic M&A by a major stablecoin issuer to expand cross-border payments capability signals real-economy use-case growth and corporate commitment to payment rails, supportive for stablecoin and crypto ecosystem demand.

Crypto.title: Stablecoins could save South Korean merchants up to $3.8 billion a year, budget office says
Crypto.reason: Official budget-office estimate quantifying merchant savings from stablecoins is a strong adoption narrative in a major economy — meaningful demand driver for stablecoin and payment-related crypto services.

Crypto.title: Liquid Network gets back 3,400 bitcoin from whitehat hackers; talks underway for the rest
Crypto.reason: Substantial recovery of stolen BTC lowers tail-risk from major hacks and supports custody/recovery confidence — a positive for market trust and counterparty risk perceptions.

Crypto.title: Cronos executes controversial blockchain rollback to recover crypto worth $111 million
Crypto.reason: Rollback recovered value but is governance-controversial, reinforcing centralization/decentralization debate and potentially undermining trust among decentralization-focused investors — modest negative on sentiment.

Crypto.title: Ethereum makes quantum resistance a top priority with a 2029 deadline
Crypto.reason: A major protocol prioritizing quantum resistance addresses long-term security risks for ETH and smart-contract ecosystems, a constructive technical development that supports institutional confidence over time.

Crypto.title: Bit2Me sets up specialized unit to help law enforcement track down crypto assets
Crypto.reason: Exchange-level cooperation with law enforcement increases asset recovery capability and compliance posture, modestly positive for institutional trust and regulatory engagement.
